items.stem: A DTO must always mirror a model's fields. What is the maintainable approach in TypeScript?

options.text: Derive the DTO from the model with utility types like Pick/Omit
options.rationale: Correct: deriving keeps the DTO in sync with the model automatically.

options.text: Hand-copy the fields into a separate interface
options.rationale: A hand copy drifts out of sync when the model changes.
A run-time clone does not produce a compile-time type.

items.explanation: Correct: deriving keeps the DTO in sync with the model automatically.
